content:
The FoC – Future of Construction project is highlighted in the TECH3 programme, broadcasted on Sundays in RTP3.

The programme dedicates 2 episodes to this SIAC project led by BUILT CoLAB that aims to define the strategy for the Twin Transition of the AEC sector, based on four structural vectors: Digitalise, Transform, Preserve and Qualify.

The second episode, broadcasted on 30 October 2022, addresses the Transform and Qualify pillars, with the contributions of Ivo Pavia, from FI Group, and Inês Vaz Pereira, from EY, who detailed the work carried out by the teams from these consultancies within the scope of the mentioned prospective studies for the AEC Sector.

In this episode João Moutinho, BUILT CoLAB Director, and Luís Gomes, from the Board of BUILT CoLAB representing Mota-Engil, also contribute to the presentation of the project and the discussion of the issues for the future of the sector.

You can review this video on RTP Play here or on BUILT CoLAB’s Youtube channel:

The first episode was broadcasted on 23 October 2022 and focuses on the Digitalise and Preserve pillars, with contributions from Miguel Taborda, from Deloitte, and António Lorena, from 3drivers, who talk about the prospective studies for the AEC Sector being carried out by these two consultants.

This video presentation of the FoC project was produced by Bubble, and supported by: Teixeira Duarte, Mota-Engil, FI Group, EY, Deloitte and 3drivers.
